title: Consolidate the duplicated v2 InputBridge (Reacciona/Apunta) into shared V2 infrastructure
description: rev-t026 LOW-3 (TASK-026 review): the ~15-line v2->InputInterpreter bridge is duplicated in ReaccionaMicrogame and ApuntaMicrogame, and the copies ALREADY diverge textually — Apunta feeds normalized diagonal stick vectors (±0.7071 via DirectionToUnit) while Reacciona's ToStickXY feeds sign-pure ±1/±1 components. They behave identically today only because InputInterpreter.ToDirection8 classifies by axis sign alone; any future magnitude-sensitive change (e.g. a deadzone) breaks the two mechanics differently. Extract a single shared bridge type in Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2 consumed by both mechanics (and every future v2 microgame), define the canonical stick-vector convention (document whether components are sign-pure or normalized), and keep the zero-alloc property (bridge allocated once, array reference reassignment, no per-tick allocation). Do this only after TASK-025 and TASK-026 are closed so it does not race their reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one bridge implementation remains in Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2, consumed by both ReaccionaMicrogame and ApuntaMicrogame; the per-mechanic copies are deleted

The canonical stick-vector convention is documented on the shared type and pinned by a test (all 9 Direction8 values round-trip through the bridge into InputInterpreter identically for both mechanics)
Zero-alloc steady-state behavior preserved and re-verified through both mechanics' existing allocation sensors
Full fast suite green with no behavioral regression (both mechanics' existing tests pass unchanged)
